## Course format

*Format du cours*

- **2 × 45 min per week**
- A mix of: main lecture, in-class activity, discussion, guest
  lecture, and a few homework assignments

## Evaluation

### Forme de l'évaluation

*Contrôle continu noté reposant sur : Continuous graded assessment
based on:*

> **Individual assignment — 30%**<br> *Devoir individuel*
> **Discussion session 1 — 20%**<br> *Séance de discussion 1*
> **Discussion session 2 — 20%**<br> *Séance de discussion 2*
> **Quiz (individual) — 30%**<br> *Quiz (individuel)*

::: {.notes}
~1 min. Both languages given in full since this is graded/binding
information - students should be able to check it in whichever
language they're more comfortable with.
:::

## Learning Goals {background-color="#1B4332"}

*Objectifs d'apprentissage*

By the end of today, you can:

- Explain what chemical ecology is and why it's interdisciplinary
- Describe the history of the field through three real discoveries
- Start your chemical ecology observations
